question: Which of the following was the mascot of the FIH men’s Hockey World Cup – 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Olly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Men’s Hockey World Cup 2023 (15th edition) is hosted by India.
 
• It was held in Bhubaneswar and Rourkela, Odisha, and Olly (Turtle) was its mascot.
 
• Belgium won the 14th edition of FIH by defeating the Nwetherlands and India was at 6th place.
 
• The Men’s Hockey World Cup 2023 (15th edition) was won by Germany.
 
• Pakistan is the most successful team with the four-time winner of this tournament.
 
• India had won only once in 1975.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/def520749233ecc29126335a40a928628abfa2a152cb2532f68228f8cd3836c4.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hockey:

 
 
• The Hockey World cup is organised by the International Hockey Federation (FIH) once in four years.
 
• The headquarters of FIH is located in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
• ‘Blackheath Rugby and Hockey Club’ was the first hockey club in the world that was set up in the year 1861 in England.
 
• The first Hockey World Cup was organised in Barcelona (Spain) in 1971 and the winner was Pakistan.
 
• India took part in Olympics for the first time in the year 1928 (in Amsterdam Olympics).
 
• In Olympics, India has won the hockey title a maximum of eight times.
